narrative.details:
Hail, adventurer.  Wild animals are growing more and more aggressive the farther we get from Goldshire, and the Eastvale Logging Camp suffers nearly constant attacks from wolves and bears!

We could use your help out here.
narrative.objectives: Kill 8 Prowlers and 5 Young Forest Bears, and then return to Guard Thomas at the east Elwynn bridge.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Thanks a lot for the help, adventurer. Something in the forest must be making these animals so bold.

Whatever it is, I hope it stays there.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you killed those wolves and bears?
